entries.title: The chapters, each with its own picture: what was unique about every season, drawn from the data

values.label: a picture per chapter (default): SCCA field gauges, F1600's seven triple-headers, the RCFFS Mid-Ohio weekend on its clock, Formula Ford's rain calendar, GB3 2021 against 2022 at the same six circuits, the Euroformula route across Europe, FR Oceania grid to flag, USF's first oval in his 2024, the Daytona 24 hours as a dial with his three spells, INDY NXT as a row a season
the chapters as they were (three stat tiles and one race strip each)

entries.look: Career → Chapters. Open each chapter tab in turn and let its picture draw in. Point at (or tap) any race mark: its card, with the track's 3D still where the venue is modelled; click (or tap again) to open the race. Daytona: the dial starts at the top at the 1:40 pm start, the shaded wedge is the night, his three spells are the thick arcs.
